diagram_previews.alt: Triangle ABC with P on AB, Q on BC and R on CA; blue segments PR and PQ, the red segment RQ with a right angle at R, its red dashed extension to the point X on line AB beyond A, and the blue dashed segment PX.

difficulty_rationale: The key idea is to reflect Q in R and to notice that the image lands on line AB; the rest is the isosceles-triangle bisector property.
